name: building-blocks-dev
install: bash scripts/install-ngrok.sh && corepack enable && cd app && pnpm install

terminals.name: dev-logs
terminals.description: Next.js dev server (nodemon) + ngrok tunnel logs. Restarts on next.config.js, middleware, prisma schema, or .env changes. Public URL is in /tmp/tower-dev/public-url.txt when NGROK_DOMAIN is configured.
